content: Jensen Huang’s stunning resignation from Nvidia after more than 33 years has sent shockwaves throughout the tech industry. Now prominent figures are calling for Huang’s reinstatement, and many are also hopping on board with a theory spreading throughout Silicon Valley: that the scandal is the result of a plot against the former CEO. At the center of this theory is the reporting from The New York Times that former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, one of multiple women Huang is accused of having an affair with, is a Chinese spy. US agencies haven’t confirmed whether this is the case, and President Donald Trump claims he was unaware of any spy allegations. Jensen Huang’s alleged relationship with Alice Huang set off the events that led to his resignation; subsequent reporting suggested he had an affair with two employees at Nvidia, including one of his direct reports. The revelation raised new questions around whether Nvidia customers, including Megaspeed, were funneling chips to China in circumvention of export restrictions. Last year, Nvidia intervened in a chip-smuggling probe surrounding the Singapore-based company, according to Bloomberg. David Sacks, a venture capitalist and former White House AI crypto advisor, has made it clear that he’s skeptical about The New York Times’ reporting. In a post on X, Sacks points to an article from CNN, which says US officials still can’t confirm that Alice Huang was a spy. “The spy narrative is collapsing already,” Sacks writes. He continued to question the spy allegations during Semafor’s Silicon Valley & The World event on Monday, saying: “The reason why Jensen lost his job is because of this lurid Chinese spy allegation. So if no one’s willing to back that up now, then again, I question why this entire chain of events happened.” Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney similarly expressed concern about how Huang’s resignation played out. In a reply to Sacks’ post about the CNN article, Sweeney said, “What?! So journalists with sketchy motives portrayed rumors from god-knows-who (lobbyists?) as facts sourced from intelligence officials and gaslit the NVIDIA board to push out the founder, CEO, and once-in-generation visionary?” Amjad Masad, the CEO of the AI app and website builder Replit, called the timing of Huang’s resignation “suspicious,” adding that “if Jensen, the premier champion of open models, is taken out then anyone who wants AI closed, centralized, and controlled might benefit.” SemiAnalysis, a research and consulting firm for the semiconductor and AI industry, posted a “conspiracy theory take on the situation,” speculating that Huang’s removal is a way to “remove opposition to an extremely hawkish China export control bill,” referring to the Remote Access Security Act (RASA). The bill, which Huang opposed, would extend AI export controls to cloud servers that allow companies in restricted countries to rent access to Nvidia’s AI chips. The Department of Commerce released an interim final rule on Monday in an attempt to address this loophole. More than 185,000 people, including Sweeney, Masad, Elon Musk, Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Shopify CEO Tobias Lütke, have signed a “Stand with Jensen” letter, calling for his reinstatement as CEO. The letter similarly calls for a closer look into the circumstances surrounding Huang’s resignation. “We have not been shown evidence substantiating the allegation that the woman at the center of this controversy was a spy,” the letter says. “Suspicion or association alone is not a sufficient basis for ending Jensen’s leadership. The inquiry must establish the facts, not merely justify an outcome already imposed.”
chineseTitle: 科技界领袖确信黄仁勋的退出是针对他的阴谋
chineseSummary: 黄仁勋在 Nvidia 工作了 33 年多后令人震惊地辞职，这在整个科技行业引起了震动。现在，知名人士呼吁黄仁勋复职，许多人也纷纷接受硅谷流传的一种理论：该丑闻是针对前首席执行官的阴谋的结果。在[…]
chineseContent: 黄仁勋在 Nvidia 工作了 33 年多后令人震惊地辞职，这在整个科技行业引起了震动。现在，知名人士呼吁黄仁勋复职，许多人也纷纷接受硅谷流传的一种理论：该丑闻是针对前首席执行官的阴谋的结果。这一理论的核心是《纽约时报》的报道称，Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是一名中国间谍，黄被指控与多名女性有染。美国机构尚未证实情况是否如此，唐纳德·特朗普总统声称他不知道任何间谍指控。黄仁勋涉嫌与黄爱丽的关系引发了导致他辞职的事件；随后的报道显示，他与英伟达的两名员工有染，其中包括他的一名直接下属。这一消息引发了新的问题：包括 Megaspeed 在内的 Nvidia 客户是否正在向中国输送芯片以规避出口限制。据彭博社报道，去年，英伟达介入了围绕这家新加坡公司的芯片走私调查。风险投资家、前白宫人工智能加密货币顾问戴维·萨克斯 (David Sacks) 明确表示，他对《纽约时报》的报道持怀疑态度。在 X 上的一篇帖子中，萨克斯提到了 CNN 的一篇文章，该文章称美国官员仍无法确认爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是间谍。 “间谍叙事已经崩溃，”萨克斯写道。周一，他在 Semafor 的《硅谷与世界》活动期间继续质疑间谍指控，并表示：“詹森丢掉工作的原因是因为这一耸人听闻的中国间谍指控。因此，如果现在没有人愿意支持这一点，那么我再次质疑为什么会发生这整个链条事件。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
